Mercury Porosimetry with The Autopore 
 Our training courses offer users, scientists, and engineers a unique opportunity to optimize their skills and maximize their investment in Micromeritics systems. 
This course provides a practical blend of theory and application, to ensure the gain of a solid understanding of mercury intrusion techniques and their real-world impact. 
In this workshop, our team of 
application experts
 will guide you through: 
Basic principles and definitions related to mercury porosimetry
Advanced methods in mercury porosimetry
Software overview and method development
Hardware overview
Practical tips and tricks (sample preparation, running analyses, etc.)
Theory with data review and reporting
PRICE: 
 1956 € per person 
DATES 
 May 14-15, 2025 
 November 19-20, 2025 
TIME 
 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM 
 Includes lunch and coffee breaks. 
Register Today! 
 Please note that seat availability is limited to 8 people.
